rootCause.primary: RTT × (auth query + heavy Prisma include fan-out)
overFetch: boqItem nested on every cell (duplicate BOQ columns × cell count)
FE also fetches /api/boq in parallel — duplicate BOQ data
approvals + reviewNotes + events + versions on every grid open
full Employee-like room fields including deletedAt/isHidden filterable server-side
rootCause.nPlusOne: No app-level N+1 loop; Prisma include issues JOINs/extra queries in one findUnique
rootCause.serialInRepo: Single findUnique — Prisma may still run multiple SQL sequentially under the hood
rootCause.note: Fusing auth into sheet SQL (like hub) + slim grid CTE could approach ~1–2 RTT

recommendations.title: Fuse auth into getById SQL (like P1.5 hub)
Split grid vs metadata endpoints OR lazy-load approvals/events/versions
recommendations.contractNote: Requires careful API contract — prefer same GET with lighter default fields if contract must stay

recommendations.title: Dedupe BOQ: cells store boqItemId only; columns from /api/boq OR one distinct boq join
recommendations.saves: smaller include; FE already loads BOQ

recommendations.title: Raw SQL CTE for sheet+rows+cells+boq in 1 RTT
